_comment: FIXTURE — curated mock data for Leafcutter Atlas mock mode (UXP-551).
current_outcome: Stable MVP that installs into any project and helps the user build good software — portable, self-onboarding, and reliable enough to use across multiple repos.

phases.title: Stable Portable MVP
phases.description: A reliable package that installs into any project via build.py, self-onboards the user via interactive config, and produces correct agents/skills/hooks without manual fixup.
exit_criteria: Clean install succeeds on a blank project with only skills_config.json present
build.py --validate-only returns 0 with no template injection errors
Consecutive builds produce zero git diff (idempotent)
Self-hosting parity: leafcutter development uses its own compiled agents
Atlas mock mode renders all 8 views from bundled fixtures

phases.title: Ecosystem Hardening
phases.description: Handle version upgrades gracefully with template migrations and config schema evolution. Support multiple concurrent consumer projects.
exit_criteria: Documented contribution workflow for adding agents and skills
Config schema validation rejects unknown keys with actionable error messages

phases.title: Distribution and Community
phases.description: Installable via a standard package manager with versioned releases, changelogs, and a documented extension mechanism.
exit_criteria: Package installable via pip or npm
Extension mechanism documented and tested with at least one community-contributed agent
